description:
A demographic analyst needs to extract the world's mega-cities from a global dataset. The Natural Earth Populated Places dataset is available as a shapefile at '/home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_populated_places_simple/ne_110m_populated_places_simple.shp'.

Perform the following steps in QGIS:
1. Open QGIS (if not already open) and add the vector layer '/home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_populated_places_simple/ne_110m_populated_places_simple.shp'.
2. Use 'Select by Expression' (or equivalent) to select all features where the attribute 'pop_max' is greater than 10,000,000 (10 million).
3. Export ONLY the selected features to a new file at '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/major_megacities.geojson' in GeoJSON format.

The output file must contain only the cities meeting the population criteria.
